# opnsense_interfaces_neighbor (Data Source)

Static ARP (IPv4) and NDP (IPv6) entries (**Interfaces ▸ Neighbors**).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the static neighbor.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address of the neighbor.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address, e.g. `02:00:00:00:00:01`.
